changesApplied.changeMade: Updated Dockerfile path from 'configs/Dockerfile.devbob' to 'docker/Dockerfile.devbob' and entrypoint path from 'configs/devbob-entrypoint.sh' to 'docker/entrypoint-self-config.sh'
changesApplied.reason: Ensures build script uses production clean binary Dockerfile (145 lines) instead of development Dockerfile (256 lines). This enforces clean environment constraint by preventing accidental builds with dev tools and source code.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects build process. Changes file path references in build script. No runtime impact. Builds will now produce clean binary images.
changesApplied.beforeBehavior: Built development image with vim, tmux, Node.js, source code workspace
changesApplied.afterBehavior: Builds production clean binary image with NO source code, only standalone binary + venv
changesApplied.complianceImprovement: Prevents accidental deployment of development images with source code leakage

changesApplied.changeMade: Added COPY instruction to include bootstrap templates from repos/metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap/ to /metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap/ in container
changesApplied.reason: Fixes container crash on startup. The binary expects bootstrap templates at /metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap/ for vessel self-configuration. Without these templates, the configure-vessel-for-environment activity cannot execute and ACP server fails to start.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium blast radius - affects container startup. Adds ~50KB of template files to image. Enables self-configuration workflow. Critical for production deployment.
changesApplied.beforeBehavior: Container crashes on startup with 'bootstrap templates not found' error
changesApplied.afterBehavior: Container starts successfully, executes self-configuration activity, ACP server starts
changesApplied.complianceImprovement: Maintains clean environment (templates are configuration, not source code) while enabling startup functionality

changesApplied.changeMade: Removed conditional 'if [ "$BACKEND_READY" = "true" ]' and made activity execution unconditional. Added backend_available variable to activity parameters.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces self-sufficiency constraint. Container must be able to configure itself independently of backend availability. By passing backend_available as a variable, the activity can adapt its behavior while always running, ensuring vessel configuration completes even in isolated environments.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - affects startup sequence. Activity now runs unconditionally. Backend availability passed as variable for activity to handle gracefully. Improves container resilience.
changesApplied.beforeBehavior: Configuration activity skipped if backend unreachable, container starts unconfigured
changesApplied.afterBehavior: Configuration activity always runs, adapts behavior based on backend_available variable, container always configured
changesApplied.complianceImprovement: Enforces DevBob self-sufficiency - can bootstrap without external dependencies

changesApplied.changeMade: Replaced 'verify-code-sync' task with 'verify-clean-binary-deployment' task. New test explicitly checks for NO source code leakage: no repos/ directory, no .ts files, workspace empty, binary exists, bootstrap templates present.
changesApplied.reason: Aligns validation tests with binary deployment architecture. Previous tests incorrectly assumed source code would exist in container (git status checks). New tests validate clean environment constraints: intellectual property protection, minimal attack surface, no source code leakage.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects validation activity. Changes test assertions from 'source code exists' to 'NO source code exists'. Prevents false failures. Correctly validates production readiness.
changesApplied.beforeBehavior: Tests checked for git repository and source files (incorrect assumption for binary deployment)
changesApplied.afterBehavior: Tests verify NO source code exists, binary deployment is clean, intellectual property protected
changesApplied.complianceImprovement: Validates the actual clean environment constraints instead of incorrect assumptions

gap-1.reason: Removing Bun requires multi-stage plugin installation. Low priority optimization. Does not affect core clean environment constraint (no source code).
